summary: Search the catalogue for a tool by name
description: Shoppers arrive knowing roughly what they want — "pliers", "hammer" — and the catalogue runs to fifty products. Search has to narrow it, say what it searched for, and be undoable without reloading the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Searching for a term shows only products whose name matches that term.
The page states what was searched for, in the form "Searched for: <term>".
A search that matches nothing shows no products and the message "There are no products found."
Clearing the search restores the unfiltered catalogue.
